Acme Solar Signs 150 MW Hybrid Power Deal with NTPC

Acme Solar has entered into a 150 MW hybrid power purchase agreement with NTPC. The project, which will combine solar, wind, and energy storage, is set to be implemented across Rajasthan, Gujarat, and Madhya Pradesh. The agreement specifies a tariff of ₹3.21 per unit for dispatchable power during peak demand hours.
